description: 带盖子的盒子（分离式上下两件）
description_en: A box with a separate lid
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
width = 80       # 宽度 (mm)
length = 60      # 长度 (mm)
height = 40      # 盒体高度 (mm)
lid_height = 10  # 盖子高度 (mm)
wall = 2         # 壁厚 (mm)
lip = 1.5        # 卡口深度 (mm)
gap = 0.2        # 间隙 (mm)

# === 盒体 ===
body = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, length, height)
    .faces(">Z").shell(-wall)
)

# === 盖子（偏移放在旁边） ===
lid = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, length, lid_height)
    .faces("<Z").shell(-wall)
    .translate((width + 10, 0, 0))
)

result = body.union(lid)

show_object(result)
